newsitem.title: FRANCE: French November raw steel output up 14.2 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: French November raw steel output up 14.2 pct y/y.

text.p: French raw steel output jumped 14.2 percent to 1.591 million tonnes in November 1996 from November 1995, statistics from the French steel federation showed.
Output for the first 11 months of 1996 reached 16.174 million tonnes, down 4.9 percent from the same period last year.
Commenting on the outlook for the steel industry, the federation said in a statement that demand for flat steels was strong within and outside the European Union and order-books well filled.
The outlook for special steel products was mixed. While prospects for the car sector were rather satisfactory, activity in the trucking and public works was down.
Demand for stainless steel products in Europe was rebounding led by household equipment and cars. This has led to a rise in prices that will continue in early 1997, it said.
